entries.description: Read docs/planning/project-guidance.md and docs/planning/lessons-learned.md. Confirmed E2E testing standards, UAT per-set checklist convention, end-of-set reorg review, "send related files to verifier" convention, the new 2026-04-19 lesson on hard-asserted disabled-state tests (promoted to Testing Conventions), and the baked-in role principle added in Set A Session 1.

Read C:/Users/denmi/.claude/plans/ok-i-did-some-abstract-blossom.md (multi-session-set roadmap for A/B/D/C). Confirmed Set B scope = 6-7 sessions; 7 roadmap items (delete old + stub five-tab layout, Role Master Details, Default Masks, data-bound enforcement, Organization Master Details, Users and Role Assignment, Role Documentation + UAT + change log).

Read docs/session-sets/rearchitecting-role-administration/rearchitecting-role-administration.md. Confirmed five top-level tabs (not four), FilterPanel<T> convention for every master-detail grid, DisplayAlias inline-editable everywhere, binary ColumnRestriction (ViewOnly|Hidden) with masking modeled separately, MudSwitch tri-state incompatibility (lesson: use MudToggleGroup), mask-exemption authority rules (separation of duties).

Read rearchitect-role-administration-foundations/change-log.md. Confirmed Set A shipped: BakedInRoles constants + 5 privilege classes + IBakedInRoleProvider + PlatformBakedInRoleProvider; ColumnRestriction, RowRestriction, UiRestriction, DefaultMaskRule, MaskExemption, OrganizationSwitching types; DisplayAlias on RoleDefinition + BakedInRoleAliasOverrides on SecurityConfiguration; RowRestrictionBroker + Expression Builder; rewritten Page/Endpoint/Control handlers; Entity/Field handlers deleted; seed migration (BackofficeUserAdmin -> baked-in CrossOrgUserAdmin, BackofficeUser/Customer as user-type roles). Follow-up items deferred to Set B: dashboard rebuild, EF org-scope query filter, [Obsolete] legacy type physical deletion (progressive).

Inventoried current-state legacy files. Admin components still present: DabblerPagePermissionMatrix, DabblerEndpointPermissionMatrix, DabblerEntityPermissionMatrix, DabblerFieldPermissionEditor, DabblerControlPermissionTab, DabblerControlPermissionEditor, DabblerRowFilterTab, DabblerRowFilterEditor, DabblerRoleManager, DenyAllowSwitch, InheritedLegend, RoleFormDialog. [Obsolete] config types still present: PagePermission, EntityPermission, FieldPermission, ControlPermission, EndpointPermission, RowFilter, RoleSwitchingPermission. EF entities still present: AppPagePermission, AppFieldPermission, AppControlPermission, AppRowFilter. RoleInheritanceHelper still on disk (zero production callers after Set A). PermissionResolver.cs still present. Consumer count (grep AllowedRoles|PagePermission|EntityPermission|FieldPermission|ControlPermission|RowFilter|RoleInheritanceHelper): 107 occurrences across 25 files, mostly in EfCoreSecurityStore, ModelBuilderExtensions, handler Requirements, and the matrix components. Confirmed dashboard currently has 7 MudTabPanel entries in DabblerSecurityDashboard.razor.

Fleshed out spec.md from stub. Now 8 sessions total: Session 1 fleshes the spec; Sessions 2-8 execute the 7 roadmap items. Each session has Steps, Creates, Touches, Ends-with, and Progress keys. Risk notes cover Session 5 size, deletion cascades, verification prompt scope, bUnit interaction coverage, disabled-state test discipline, Playwright churn between Sessions 2-8, and role-switch reactivity. Exit criteria at whole-set level. Detailed confirmation of Set A deliverables vs. Set B needs recorded upfront so the verifier can sanity-check without re-reading Set A.

Build: 0 errors, 506 warnings (all CS0618 [Obsolete] warnings from Set A's legacy types still pending progressive deletion in Sessions 2-8). Non-Playwright tests: 577 passed, 1 pre-existing failure (AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests.WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates expects docs/workflow-auth-observability.md which was deleted in commit 8730107; failure unrelated to this session and already tracked in Set A Session 5). Baseline confirmed green aside from known pre-existing drift.

Cross-provider verification via ai-router (round 1). Model: opus. Tokens in/out: 22256/2223. Prompt attached spec.md, architecture doc, and Set A change-log; disclosed planning docs, roadmap, and current executable code as out-of-scope. See session-reviews/session-001.md for raw output.

Round 2 cross-provider verification via ai-router. Model: opus. Tokens in/out: 18580/1612. Re-verified all 7 fixes from round 1 plus checks for new issues. See session-reviews/session-001-review-002.md for raw output.

Committed spec.md + activity-log.json + issue-logs/session-001.json + session-reviews/session-001.md as Session 1 of 8. Pushed to origin/master (8e9864c). Pushover notification sent. Step 9 reorganization review is NOT run here (only on the last session of the set — Session 8).
Read docs/planning/project-guidance.md, docs/planning/lessons-learned.md, spec.md, and Session 1 activity-log. Confirmed Session 2 scope and the 'best-effort' deletion hedge in Session 2 Ends-with.

Grepped all consumers of legacy types and admin components. Found PermissionService, EfCoreSecurityStore, JsonFileSecurityStore, RowFilterService, DabblerRoleSwitcher, UserContextBar still reference obsolete fields (PagePermissions, EntityPermissions, FieldPermissions, ControlPermissions, EndpointPermissions, RowFilters, RoleSwitching). Per spec Ends-with hedge, legacy type physical deletion is deferred to the sessions that rewrite those consumers.

Rewrote DabblerSecurityDashboard.razor from seven MudTabPanel entries to five stub tabs (Role Master Details, Default Masks, Organization Master Details, Users and Role Assignment, Role Documentation). Each tab renders a stub message keyed by data-testid identifying the future session that wires real content (Sessions 3/4/6/7/8). Kept arrow-key navigation via NextPanelIndex static helper.

Each TabDescriptor carries AllowedBakedInRoles. OnInitializedAsync resolves the active ClaimsPrincipal's effective roles through IRoleSwitcher, maps those to baked-in canonical names via IBakedInRoleProvider.TryGetBakedInRole, and filters AllTabs to the subset matching AllowedBakedInRoles. Tabs the active role cannot see are not rendered. Gating matches the spec: Role Master Details + Default Masks = SystemAdmin only; Organization Master Details = SystemAdmin + CrossOrgUserAdmin; Users and Role Assignment = SystemAdmin + CrossOrgUserAdmin + UserAdmin; Role Documentation = all five baked-in roles.

Deleted 12 legacy admin razor components: DabblerPagePermissionMatrix, DabblerEndpointPermissionMatrix, DabblerEntityPermissionMatrix, DabblerFieldPermissionEditor, DabblerControlPermissionTab, DabblerControlPermissionEditor, DabblerRowFilterTab, DabblerRowFilterEditor, DabblerRoleManager, DenyAllowSwitch, InheritedLegend, RoleFormDialog. DabblerUserRoleManager retained (Session 7 adapts it). DabblerSecured.razor rewritten to use UiRestrictions + IBakedInRoleProvider (replaces config.ControlPermissions lookup). Moved ControlState enum out of the [Obsolete] ControlPermission.cs file into its own ControlState.cs so DabblerSecured does not depend on an obsolete file.

DEFERRED per the session Ends-with hedge. Physical deletion of PagePermission, EntityPermission, FieldPermission, ControlPermission, EndpointPermission, RowFilter, RoleSwitchingPermission did NOT land this session because non-UI consumers still reference them: PermissionService (entity CRUD checks consumed by Orders/Customers/Products controllers), EfCoreSecurityStore/JsonFileSecurityStore (load/save roundtrip), RowFilterService (superseded by RowRestrictionBroker but not yet removed), DabblerRoleSwitcher/UserContextBar (RoleSwitching.AllowedRoles). Each of those consumers has its own future session in Set B (Session 5 restriction seam, Session 6 org filter, Session 7 users + role assignment) or Set D that will remove the dependency. When the last non-UI consumer goes away, the type's deletion lands in that session.

DEFERRED for the same reason. AppPagePermission, AppFieldPermission, AppControlPermission, AppRowFilter, AppEndpointPermission survive because EfCoreSecurityStore + ModelBuilderExtensions + DbContext DbSets still map them. Physical deletion requires an EF migration and will land alongside the store rewrite in the session that removes the last consumer.
Deleted RoleInheritanceHelper.cs. Had zero production callers after Set A. Removed its stale doc-comment reference from EndpointAuthorizationHandlerTests.cs.
Deleted PermissionResolver.cs and PermissionResolverTests.cs. The only consumers were the legacy matrix components deleted in this session. Matches Step 7a's most-likely outcome.

DabblerSecurityNav.razor is unchanged — it points at /admin/security (the new five-tab dashboard) which is the same route, and it does not reference any of the deleted sub-components. Spot-checked DabblerSecured consumers and the dashboard page attribute; both compile.

Deleted SecurityDashboardUserAssignmentsTests.cs — it targeted the legacy 'User Assignments' tab which no longer exists; the equivalent coverage returns in Session 7 once the Users and Role Assignment tab is real. Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, spec.md, activity-log for Sessions 1-2. Confirmed restriction-based model, baked-in role surface, MetadataRegistry requirement, and the MudToggleGroup vs MudSwitch lesson from security-dashboard-polish.

Created src/Libs/Dabbler.Security/Registration/MetadataRegistry.cs as a thin DI-registered facade over ResourceRegistry exposing Tables/GetColumns/Pages/GetControls plus EntirePageControlKey ("*") and EntirePageDisplayName constants. Registered singleton in Extensions/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs alongside ResourceRegistry. Kept ResourceRegistry as-is so handlers keep their entity/field vocabulary.

Added src/Libs/Dabbler.Security/Services/MaskExemptionAuthority.cs encoding the separation-of-duties rules from MaskExemption xml-doc + architecture doc: user-type/UserAdmin targets allow SystemAdmin or CrossOrgUserAdmin (no expiry required); SystemAdmin/CrossOrgMonitor targets require CrossOrgUserAdmin granter and non-null ExpiresAt; CrossOrgUserAdmin target is self-grant only with expiry. Returns structured (Outcome, Message) so the UI can distinguish Denied vs ExpiryRequired.

Created Components/Admin/Role/RoleMasterGrid.razor (+RoleRow nested class): FilterPanel<RoleRow> over CanonicalName/DisplayAlias/Description, MudDataGrid listing baked-in rows (greyed, "baked-in" chip) + user-type rows combined, inline-editable DisplayAlias with 400ms debounce writing to BakedInRoleAliasOverrides (baked-in) or RoleDefinition.DisplayAlias (user-type). Add/Archive affordances gated by CanManageRoles. Add button opens AddUserTypeRoleDialog.razor (MudDialog).

Created Components/Admin/Role/RoleDetailsSection.razor with a RoleSelection record that dispatches: user-type -> four sub-tabs (Data Column/Row/UI Restrictions + Mask Exemptions); baked-in -> two sub-tabs (Mask Exemptions + Compiled Privileges). Baked-in chip rendered in header when selection IsBakedIn.

Created Components/Admin/Role/ColumnRestrictionsSubTab.razor. MudSelect cascading Table->Column from MetadataRegistry; MudToggleGroup<ColumnRestrictionKind> (ViewOnly | Hidden, no Allow). Add/Remove/kind-change all persist through SecurityConfigurationManager.SaveAsync and raise OnPersisted.

Created Components/Admin/Role/RowRestrictionsSubTab.razor: MudSelect Table + MudTextField filter expression (debounced). Placeholder "e.g. CustomerId == @CurrentUserId" bound via const field to avoid Razor @ escape issues.

Created Components/Admin/Role/UiRestrictionsSubTab.razor: MudSelect cascading Page->Control from MetadataRegistry; first control item is "Entire Page" mapped to "*" via MetadataRegistry.EntirePageControlKey. MudToggleGroup<UiRestrictionKind> (Disabled | Hidden). Renamed loop var to avoid Razor treating @page as a directive.

Created Components/Admin/Role/MaskExemptionsSubTab.razor. Works for user-type AND baked-in target roles (parameter TargetRoleName). Table/Column cascading sourced from SecurityConfiguration.DefaultMasks (empty-state alert shown until Session 4 ships the Default Masks tab). Resolves granter baked-in role via AuthenticationStateProvider + IRoleSwitcher + IBakedInRoleProvider, then calls MaskExemptionAuthority.Evaluate on each Add. Denied/ExpiryRequired surface as inline MudAlert. Expired rows render struck-through with Status chip + Renew action (renewal is +30 days, re-checked against authority).

Created Components/Admin/Role/BakedInPrivilegesPanel.razor: read-only MudSimpleTable listing every BakedInRolePrivileges flag as a row with success/neutral icons. Alias override banner shown when configured, default alias shown otherwise.

Created Components/Admin/Role/RoleMasterDetailsTab.razor top-level composer: injects AuthenticationStateProvider/IRoleSwitcher/IBakedInRoleProvider, resolves CanManageRoles once for the active user, wires grid SelectedRoleChanged -> RoleSelection -> RoleDetailsSection. Subscribes to AuthorizationStateNotifier so an external config change (e.g., Session 4 Default Masks addition) rebuilds the grid in-circuit.

Seeded Customer.SocialSecurityNumber with MaskFormat "XXX-XX-{last4}" in both src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web/security-config.json and the Api copy so Session 3 Mask Exemptions cascading dropdowns have real source data before Session 4 ships the Default Masks tab. Suggested by spec step 9.

DabblerSecurityDashboard.razor: replaced the Role Master Details stub message with <RoleMasterDetailsTab /> via a TabKey switch. Other four tabs remain as Session-4/6/7/8 stubs. Added Dabbler.Components project reference to Dabbler.Security.Blazor.csproj so FilterPanel<T> could be consumed.

Added tests/Dabbler.Security.Tests/Services/MaskExemptionAuthorityTests.cs (18 tests covering every granter+target+expiry combination in the authority matrix). Added tests/Dabbler.Security.Tests/Registration/MetadataRegistryTests.cs (8 tests covering Tables/GetTable/GetColumns/Pages/GetControls plus the EntirePage constants and Empty singleton).

Added tests/Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests/Components/Admin/Role/ directory with {BakedInPrivilegesPanelTests, RoleMasterDetailsTabTests, RoleDetailsSectionTests, ColumnRestrictionsSubTabTests, MaskExemptionsSubTabTests}.cs. Cover baked-in privilege flag rendering, alias override display, user-type vs baked-in sub-tab dispatching, grid row rendering with baked-in chip, Add/Archive affordance gating by CanManageRoles, ColumnRestriction inline Remove persistence and OnPersisted callback, MaskExemptions empty state, active vs expired status chips, cross-role filtering.

Created src/Libs/Dabbler.Security.Blazor/Components/Admin/Masks/DefaultMasksGrid.razor: FilterPanel<DefaultMaskRule> (Table/Column/Mask format text contains) + add-row form (cascading MudSelect Table → Column from MetadataRegistry + MudTextField MaskFormat with {last4}/{firstChar} helper text) + MudDataGrid with inline-editable MaskFormat (debounced 400ms), delete button per row, visible "N of M declared masks" count label, and empty-state text. Duplicate-guard on Add keyed by (EntityKey, ColumnKey). Exposed public AddFromSafetyNetAsync(entityKey, columnKey) so the parent tab can delegate the safety-net one-click add.

Created Components/Admin/Masks/SensitiveNameSafetyNet.razor. Compiled regex /ssn|taxid|ein|dob|password|ccnum|salary/i (case-insensitive) evaluated against every (table, column) pair in MetadataRegistry.Tables, filtered by an OrdinalIgnoreCase hashset of already-declared DefaultMasks. Renders a collapsible MudCollapse panel with a "Warning" alert when undeclared matches exist and a green Severity.Success alert when clear. Each row has an "Add to Default Masks" button that emits OnAddMatch so the parent tab funnels the add through a single persistence path. Rebuild() is public and calls StateHasChanged so the parent can trigger a rescan after persisting.

Created Components/Admin/Masks/DefaultMasksTab.razor: thin composer that subscribes to AuthorizationStateNotifier on init and disposes on teardown. OnGridPersistedAsync rescans the safety net. OnAddFromSafetyNetAsync routes the safety-net click through the grid's AddFromSafetyNetAsync so a single code path governs persistence, snackbar, and cross-tab notification. OnConfigChangedAsync rescans when a SIBLING tab (e.g., Mask Exemptions sub-tab) mutates the configuration within the same circuit.

DabblerSecurityDashboard.razor: added @using for the Masks namespace and replaced the Default Masks stub with <DefaultMasksTab /> via the existing TabKey switch. SystemAdmin-only gating already lands in Session 2.

Updated Components/Admin/Role/MaskExemptionsSubTab.razor to subscribe to AuthorizationStateNotifier and Dispose the subscription. OnConfigChangedAsync calls RebuildTableKeys + InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged) so the cascading Table/Column dropdowns react within the same circuit when the Default Masks tab adds or removes a rule. This is the "push through a notification event" item from the Session 4 spec.

Created src/Libs/Dabbler.Security.Blazor/Components/Restriction/ tree: RestrictionResolution.cs (readonly record struct with Visibility/Editability/IsMasked/MaskFormat plus ColumnVisibility + ColumnEditability enums and Unrestricted factory), IRestrictionBinder.cs (async ResolveAsync + pure synchronous Resolve overload for tests/non-Blazor consumers), RestrictionBinder.cs (instance impl injecting SecurityConfigurationManager + AuthenticationStateProvider + IRoleSwitcher + IBakedInRoleProvider; pure static Evaluate covers multi-role most-permissive aggregation, baked-in short-circuit, default-mask + per-role exemption with ExpiresAt expiry).

Created Components/Restriction/RestrictedFormField.razor: subscribes to AuthorizationStateNotifier, calls Binder.ResolveAsync on init + on every notification + on key change. Render contract: Hidden -> nothing; Masked + no exemption -> MaskedTemplate (default placeholder span with data-masked='true'/data-mask-format/data-testid='restricted-field-masked-{entity}-{column}'); otherwise -> ChildContent(RestrictionResolution) so the consumer wires Disabled/ReadOnly from state.Editability.

Created Components/Restriction/RestrictedGridColumn.razor (analogous wrapper for MudDataGrid columns). Hidden -> emits no column (MudDataGrid registers only columns that render); otherwise -> invokes ChildContent(state) so the consumer wires IsEditable / Editable / CellTemplate from state. Masked rendering left to the consumer because grids have N cells with per-row values; documented in xml-doc.

Adapted ProductDetail.razor: wrapped the UnitPrice MudNumericField in <RestrictedFormField EntityKey='Product' ColumnKey='UnitPrice'> with Disabled+ReadOnly bound to restriction.Editability. Adapted ProductList.razor: wrapped the UnitPrice PropertyColumn in <RestrictedGridColumn EntityKey='Product' ColumnKey='UnitPrice'> with Editable bound to restriction.Editability. Both files now @using Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Components.Restriction.

Registered AddScoped<IRestrictionBinder, RestrictionBinder>() in Dabbler.Security.Blazor/Extensions/ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddDabblerSecurityBlazor (NOT in Dabbler.Security; that direction would create a Security -> Security.Blazor cycle). Scoped lifetime matches IRoleSwitcher so the binder sees role-switch state for the current circuit.

Added WarehouseUser user-type role to security-config.json (both Web and Api copies) plus SecuritySeedData.cs: a single ColumnRestriction (Product/UnitPrice = Hidden) so the Hidden-path Playwright test has a real role to drive. Extended appsettings.Development.json SeededSession.AllowedRoles with WarehouseUser. The pre-existing BackofficeUser role had /products Hidden which would block the Playwright proof, so a dedicated test role was the cleanest path.

Added tests/Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests/Components/Restriction/RestrictionBinderTests.cs (16 facts covering: NoRoles unrestricted; baked-in short-circuit; ViewOnly + Hidden single-role; role-not-in-config default-permissive; multi-role most-permissive across visibility and editability; both-ViewOnly stays ReadOnly; both-Hidden stays Hidden; default-mask without exemption; active exemption; expired exemption stays masked; exemption for other role stays masked; baked-in role in user set always unmasked; permanent exemption; entity/column key echoed in result).

Added RestrictedFormFieldTests.cs (7 facts: Hidden renders nothing; ViewOnly passes ReadOnly state; no-restriction passes Editable state; baked-in bypasses; default-mask renders placeholder span; custom MaskedTemplate overrides default; AuthorizationStateChange triggers re-resolution within circuit). Added RestrictedGridColumnTests.cs (5 facts: Hidden does not invoke ChildContent; ViewOnly passes ReadOnly; no-restriction passes Editable; default-mask still invokes child with masked state; AuthorizationStateChange removes column from render).
